title: Austin's Budget Focus: Health, Safety, Planning
summary:
*   Austin officials held a dedicated budget worksession to review city finances and upcoming expenditures.
*   Directors from key public services, including Brackenridge Hospital, the Health Department, Fire, and Emergency Medical Services, presented their proposed budgets.
*   The Planning Department also outlined its financial needs, with department heads engaging in discussions and answering questions from officials regarding their plans.
*   This meeting was a crucial step in the city's annual financial planning process, focusing on resource allocation for essential public services.

August 07, 1991 SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
TOWN LAKE CENTER - 9:00 Α.Μ.
BUDGET WORKSESSION
Mayor Todd called to order the Special Called Meeting of the Council, noting the absence
of Mayor Pro Tem Urdy. The Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a budget
worksession.
John Dandridge Jr., Director of Brackenridge Hospital; Sue Noffke, Director, Austin/Travis
County Health Department, Bill Roberts, Fire Chief; David Vuertz, Director of Emergency
Medical Services; and Mike Heitz, Acting Director, Planning Department, all presented
their budgets to Council. Copies of their reports are on file in the City Clerk's office.
After questions and discussion by members of the Council concerning each department, the
Special Called Meeting was adjourned at 12:00 Noon. i
